notes: Thirty source and forty-two target tokens partitioned exactly once.

The waw of וְאֵין takes *so that* under rule 14's open list; the competing reading treats *that* as a supplied subordinator under rule 55 and marks the waw unrepresented, and it is named in the unit note.
t035 *it* is added: מְכַבֶּה carries no object morpheme, and rule 44 forbids folding an unsupported object pronoun into the verb's unit.
מִפְּנֵי fuses to *because of* here because no morpheme owns a part of the compound preposition (rule 30, read as one English rendering rather than one token).
